equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity appears only as a descriptor of survey participants (74% White, 81% non-Hispanic); age and sex are descriptors only. No group-specific results are reported.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional from the self-administered survey; the Epi-Aid could also be read as an outbreak (exposure-incident) investigation. Symptom systems are ranked by percentage, but these are outcomes, not groups compared; improvement after switching water is a single self-reported proportion, not a computed before/after contrast. Household response rates use U.S. Navy household data as a denominator.
view_issues: Denominators for some percentages are unstated, e.g. 1,115 (52%) residents reporting contamination indications implies a resident subtotal not given.
